create_BasicSceneframeDataset: create a BasicSceneframeDataset from a Box config with root, frame_modalities, and key_remap settings
use_collate_fn: use the collate_fn static method to stack a batch of scene-frame dictionaries into a single batch
load_scene_frame: load a specific scene frame by scene name and frame name with requested modalities and key remapping
iterate_dataset_frames: iterate over scene-frame pairs using the dataset as a PyTorch Dataset with __getitem__ and __len__
cache_scene_data: cache scene metadata in the dataset to avoid reloading scene_meta.json on repeated frame access
